basis: Original PDF sections6.1/6.2, existing source descriptors and official GitHub API documentation. No live calls or family acceptance.

families.semantics: Archive is repos.update with archived=true (repos.archive is a fixed-body compatibility wrapper); write.preflight is diagnostic. Missing create remains required, not removed by fixed existing-repository scope.
unresolved_capabilities: Repository creation for an explicitly authorized owner/new resource has no canonical callable handler.

families.semantics: Issue CRUD includes close/reopen via update.state, comments, assignment, labels, dependencies, subissues, issue fields, reactions and suggestions. Repository notifications/events and commit comments are supporting cross-family candidates, not issue CRUD aliases.

Discussions use fixed GraphQL documents with server-resolved repository/discussion/comment ownership. Reply creation is comments.create(reply_to_comment_id); answer marking, close/reopen and cursor pagination are distinct required behavior.

Existing REST package/version list/get/delete/restore is post-publication management, not package publishing. Repository association and immutable package/version IDs remain necessary; a package-manager publishing adapter is a recorded gap.
unresolved_capabilities: Publishing an owned artifact through a supported package-manager adapter, then verifying exact package/version/digest.

families.semantics: Check runs and suites are separate objects. Create/update, suite preferences, annotations, list/get and re-request are distinct; GitHub App authority for writes cannot be inferred from successful metadata reads or commit-status authority.

Statuses are append-only observations per SHA/context, not an update/delete resource. Create, list and combined status are required; a combined success alone cannot attest a particular context or independent build execution.

Deployment create and status create/list/get form this explicit family. Deployment list/get supports independent readback. Deleting deployments is supporting cleanup, not implied by create/status scope. GitHub deployment records are not proof that a workload deployed.

Explicit list/update includes get for verification. The environment PUT can create or replace configuration; protection-rule and branch-policy administration are separate candidates, not authorized by this mapping. Existing rules/reviewers must be preserved.

Repository secret set/remove requires trusted ciphertext custody and repository public-key binding. rotate is a semantic reuse of set with new ciphertext, not a separate endpoint. Metadata reads cannot retrieve values or prove workload use.
unresolved_capabilities: Trusted ciphertext custody and exact public-key/target binding with workload-use evidence for rotation.

families.semantics: Repository variables create and update are separate provider operations; set is PATCH, not an upsert. Environment-variable CRUD shares this configuration family. Lists and exact get are required to verify effects; values are non-secret configuration.

Environment secrets use exact environment and key identity; metadata get/list/public-key/set/delete are distinct. Rotation reuses set. Plaintext and secret ciphertext cannot be used as public result evidence.
unresolved_capabilities: Trusted environment-secret ciphertext custody, target/key binding and rotation-use evidence.

families.semantics: Webhook CRUD, exact get, delivery list/get and redelivery cover the explicit scope. Ping/test and separate config reads/writes are supporting endpoints. Redelivery can trigger external effects and needs exact owned delivery and receiver confirmation.
unresolved_capabilities: Owned receiver signature-verification and correlated delivery/redelivery outcome evidence.

families.semantics: Collaborator invitations/permissions and repository teams are related but distinct. Existing collaborator and invitation handlers plus teams listing do not implement team-to-repository permission grant/change/revoke; the missing lifecycle remains a blocker.
unresolved_capabilities: Team-to-repository permission get/grant/update/revoke lifecycle with canonical organization/team/repository bindings.

families.semantics: Ruleset CRUD, effective branch rules, history/version and evaluation suites are distinct. Effective rules can originate above the repository; readback must not imply authority to edit inherited organization rules.

Organization audit is filtered to the configured repository and a bounded date window. Existing owner must actually be an organization with provider entitlement; no substitution of a different organization or audit credential is allowed.

Security alert listing includes Dependabot, secret-scanning and code-scanning families; alert get/update and advisory tracking are distinct from enabling a security product. Existing broad candidates are retained conservatively; no security setting is activated.

Code scanning includes alerts/instances, analyses, SARIF upload/status, databases, variant analyses, autofix and setup settings. Upload accepted is not analysis completion; asynchronous status and functional outcome verification remain required.
unresolved_capabilities: Canonical asynchronous SARIF/variant-analysis/autofix completion and recovery evidence.
